indicator.name: Ward-level development fund allocation
indicator.description: Ward-level development fund allocation where separately and officially reported.
indicator.expected_source: NG-CDF Act, 2015 (as amended); non-uniform county Ward Development Fund legislation; County Wards (Equitable Development) Bill, 2024 (not enacted)
indicator.expected_availability_note: No uniform official national ward-fund programme exists (NG-CDF is constituency-level; county Ward Development Funds are ad hoc and non-uniform; the County Wards (Equitable Development) Bill is not enacted). Closed not_applicable under data/p24/ward-fund-allocation-closure-contract.json rather than divided from a county/constituency total.
